title: Sparkly present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='boxShine' cx='30%' cy='20%' r='80%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fb1'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e04070'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='ribbonShine' cx='50%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0b400'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Present box -->
  <rect x='20' y='45' width='60' height='42' rx='4' fill='url(#boxShine)'/>
  <rect x='20' y='45' width='60' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff9fc0'/>
  <!-- Box lid -->
  <rect x='17' y='38' width='66' height='12' rx='3' fill='#ff6f9a'/>
  <rect x='17' y='38' width='66' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffb3cc'/>
  <!-- Vertical ribbon -->
  <rect x='45' y='38' width='10' height='49' fill='url(#ribbonShine)'/>
  <rect x='45' y='38' width='3' height='49' fill='#fff0a0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Bow loops -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='30' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#f0b400' transform='rotate(-20 35 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='30' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#f0b400' transform='rotate(20 65 30)'/>
  <!-- Bow loop highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='27' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffe680' transform='rotate(-20 33 27)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='27' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffe680' transform='rotate(20 67 27)'/>
  <!-- Bow center knot -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#ffd633'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#fff2a8'/>
  <!-- Bow tails -->
  <path d='M48 36 Q40 44 34 50' stroke='#e0a800' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 36 Q60 44 66 50' stroke='#e0a800' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff8c0'>
    <path d='M12 20 l2 4 4 2-4 2-2 4-2-4-4-2 4-2z'/>
    <path d='M85 15 l1.5 3 3 1.5-3 1.5-1.5 3-1.5-3-3-1.5 3-1.5z'/>
    <path d='M88 60 l1.5 3 3 1.5-3 1.5-1.5 3-1.5-3-3-1.5 3-1.5z'/>
    <path d='M10 65 l1.5 3 3 1.5-3 1.5-1.5 3-1.5-3-3-1.5 3-1.5z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffe680'>
    <path d='M25 80 l1 2 2 1-2 1-1 2-1-2-2-1 2-1z'/>
    <path d='M75 78 l1 2 2 1-2 1-1 2-1-2-2-1 2-1z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#fff8c0'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#fff8c0'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='30' r='1' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='45' r='1' fill='#ffe680'/>
</svg>
